new.brief: Creates a new scroll info for scrolling an element into view.
new.md: Creates a new scroll info for scrolling an element into view.

doc.brief: Provides detailed information on how a scroll operation should be performed.
doc.md:
Provides detailed information on how a scroll operation should be performed.

Scrolling functions usually allow passing a `NULL` scroll info which will
cause the default values to be used and just scroll the element into view.

get_enable_horizontal.brief: Checks if horizontal scrolling is enabled.
get_enable_horizontal.md: Checks if horizontal scrolling is enabled.

get_enable_vertical.brief: Checks if vertical scrolling is enabled.
get_enable_vertical.md: Checks if vertical scrolling is enabled.

ref.brief: Increases the reference count of a `GtkScrollInfo` by one.
ref.md: Increases the reference count of a `GtkScrollInfo` by one.

set_enable_horizontal.brief: Turns horizontal scrolling on or off.
set_enable_horizontal.md: Turns horizontal scrolling on or off.

set_enable_vertical.brief: Turns vertical scrolling on or off.
set_enable_vertical.md: Turns vertical scrolling on or off.

unref.brief: Decreases the reference count of a `GtkScrollInfo` by one.
unref.md:
Decreases the reference count of a `GtkScrollInfo` by one.

If the resulting reference count is zero, frees the self.
